title: Derive Purchase Order receipt and settlement progress
description: Close the audited Purchase Order progress gap with read-oriented progress derived from existing purchase order, stock-in and finance/settlement records. Do not introduce production schema changes or mutate production data outside existing document workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Purchase Order detail exposes ordered, received and outstanding quantities derived from existing records.
Where existing finance/settlement records can be linked safely, expose settled and outstanding amounts without inventing data.
Partial receipts and multiple receipts aggregate correctly and queries remain bounded.
Missing settlement linkage is represented explicitly rather than guessed.
Unit/integration tests cover no receipt, partial receipt, complete receipt and available settlement linkage; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open a partially received Purchase Order and inspect progress.
Open a fully received Purchase Order and inspect progress.

human_gate.reason: Read-oriented derivation from existing persisted records; no schema/deployment action.
